data.one_liner: Implements the DIDComm v2 Messaging protocol for secure and private app communication.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools and libraries to send, receive, sign, and encrypt DIDComm v2 messages within your application. Supports various encryption algorithms, DID methods like did:peer and did:key, and connection to mediator services.
use_when: You need secure, private, and decentralized messaging using Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs).
Your app requires authenticated encryption (authcrypt) or anonymous encryption (anoncrypt) for message transport.
avoid_when: You are building a standard REST or GraphQL client without decentralized identity requirements.
You only need standard push notifications or real-time web sockets without DIDComm protocol framing.
strengths: Comprehensive support for DIDComm v2 message envelopes (plaintext, signed, authcrypt, anoncrypt).
Supports multiple curves and algorithms like Ed25519, P-256, P-384, and P-521.
Integrates with Affinidi Dart SSI for digital wallets and DID management.
weaknesses: Niche protocol domain with a steeper learning curve regarding decentralized identity and DID methods.
Certain curves and content encryption algorithms have platform-specific limitations or lack full spec support.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up DID Manager, wallets via Affinidi Dart SSI, and proper cryptographic keys.
